text: Very comfortable, nice and clean dental clinic. The dentist (Dr. Kansinee) is very friendly and takes care of her patient well. The clinic is in Ruamchoke Mall so it is convenient to do shopping in the nearby local market, Tops grocery store, Rimping, etc. Parking space is available for free (up to 4 hours with the store's stamp on the parking ticket).
Wonderful experience with cleaning and filling for receding gum line! I will come back! Thank you to staff for a beautiful, no pain job and cleanliness during covid 19 pandemic! A+++++++

Since the ownership changed from the purple clinic to the green clinic, the service has deteriorated significantly. Time management is terrible, and many people have to wait in agonizingly long and frustrating situations. Appointments clash, with people arriving later being served first. There's no one at the counter to greet customers; even shouting to get their attention doesn't help. If you're going to make people wait after making an appointment, what's the point of having an appointment schedule? Now, you have to specify your time and what you need done, unlike before. Previously, the clinic would know what each person was waiting for without needing to be told; they just asked for your name and said "please wait." Now, you have to tell them everything yourself. The same thing happened with appointments. Normally, the clinic would suggest times, but now you have to choose your own time. (I won't go into details about this, but the person making the appointment told me the exact time and date, but they didn't provide any specific information until I randomly chose a date. Hi!)
I went for a teeth cleaning and polishing. Everything was good and the price was reasonable. I've never had any problems.
